import nbformat
from nbconvert.preprocessors import ExecutePreprocessor
from nbconvert import HTMLExporter
from pathlib import Path

infile = Path('FS-Filters.ipynb')
outdir = Path('/results')
outdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
executed_path = outdir / 'FS-Filters.executed.ipynb'
html_path = outdir / 'FS-Filters.html'

nb = nbformat.read(infile, as_version=4)
ep = ExecutePreprocessor(timeout=None, kernel_name='python3', allow_errors=True)
ep.preprocess(nb, {'metadata': {'path': '/code'}})
nbformat.write(nb, executed_path)

html_exporter = HTMLExporter()
(body, resources) = html_exporter.from_notebook_node(nb)
html_path.write_text(body, encoding='utf-8')
print('Wrote', executed_path)
print('Wrote', html_path)
PY
